flagged.title: The Hoplite & the Phalanx
flagged.reason: The video states at 02:10 that the shield protected the left side of the man to the right, reversing the physical mechanics of the phalanx formation and shield overlap, which would lose marks on exam questions testing phalanx warfare.

mark_affecting.quote: it also extended out to protect the left side of the guy standing to his right.

mark_affecting.video_says: your left side was perfectly protected by your own shield and the man to your left, but your right side, it was totally exposed, relying entirely on the shield of the guy standing to your right
mark_affecting.lesson_says: Each man's hoplon covered his own left side and the right side of the man to his left

flagged.title: Salamis & Naval Warfare
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly presents Mardonius's army as instantly doomed and isolated rather than mentioning that Mardonius retained a substantial force, overwintered in Boeotia/Thessaly, and recaptured Athens in 479 BC before Plataea.

mark_affecting.quote: leaving his general Mardonius behind with this doomed, isolated land force. The very next year in 479 BC, that unsupported army is finally decisively wiped out at the land battle of Plataea.
